title: The transcriptional signature of human ovarian carcinoma macrophages is associated with extracellular matrix reorganization and disease progression
description: RNAseq of peritoneal macrophages from patients with non-malignent peritoneal afflictions.

samples.title: MDM2
samples.description: Protocols: MDMs were made from peripheral blood monocytes, differentiation for 6. After Ficoll gradient centrifugation, TAMs were purified by CD14 MACS and lysed in Peqgold (TRIzol-like solution based on phenol and chloroform). RNA was digested with DNase (MN) and purified on a Qiagen Minelute column. Illumina-compatible libraries were made using the Epicentre Scriptseq human/mouse/rat low input Gold kit. Illumina-compatible libraries were made using the Epicentre Scriptseq human/mouse/rat low input Gold kit.
